pins.definition: Having a great weight; difficult to lift or carry.
Having a lot of physical weight.

situation: A dock worker is trying to lift an enormous, iron-bound wooden shipping crate that refuses to budge.
subject: the physical weight of the crate
brief: A man in work clothes is strained to his absolute limit, his knees buckling and the muscles in his neck standing out like cords as he grips the edge of an immense wooden crate. The floorboards beneath the crate are visibly bowed and creaking under the pressure, and the crate itself appears solid and immovable, defying his desperate attempt to lift it even a fraction of an inch off the ground.
